rules.name: human/agent common authorization boundary
rules.requirement: Human UI, REST/API, MCP and agent-originated operations MUST resolve through the same authoritative FA3 policy boundary and MUST NOT gain an agent-only bypass.

rules.name: capability-surface drift gate
rules.requirement: Declared equivalent capability projections MUST match the canonical capability manifest; missing, extra or widened capability/permission projections MUST fail closed.

rules.name: change-surface closure
rules.requirement: Every change MUST declare applicable contract, authorization, API, MCP, SDK/client, event/realtime, persistence/migration and deployment surfaces, and every declared applicable surface MUST have PASS evidence before closure.

rules.name: distributed security-state
rules.requirement: Security-relevant ephemeral state crossing replicas MUST use shared state with expiry, atomic consume and replay protection; replica-local state is forbidden for distributed protocol continuity.
